QuestInfo.name: The Lost Big Saddle
QuestInfo.0: You lost the #t1912034#! What to do? Ask #b#p2060005##k in #b#m230000000##k to make you another saddle.
QuestInfo.1: #p2060005# is angry that you lost the saddle he made you... He will only make you another saddle if you give him #b60 million mesos#k, as well as the #bsame materials as before#k.\n
QuestInfo.2: You received the #t1912034# from #p2060005# after getting all the materials again and paying double the mesos. Be careful not to lose it again...

0.0: Hello. How are you enjoying your saddle? Wait, where is your saddle? Eek! You want me to make you another saddle? You didn't lose the saddle, did you?
0.1: I worked so hard to make such a nice saddle for you. How could you lose it? You really don't take care of your stuff. Honestly, I really don't want to make another one for someone like you...
0.2: But, fine. I'll make you a new one just this once. There is a condition however. You'll have to bring me the materials just like before but you'll have to pay double the fee.

yes.0: You do remember what the materials were right? The #b2 #t4032505#s#k, which can be obtained from Aqua Road Ocean I.C, Crystal George, Red Coral Forest, or Turban Shell Hill. And, #m251000000#'s specialty, #b2 pieces of #t4032477##k, and...
yes.1: You will also need to pay me a #bfee of 60 million mesos#k. It may seem like a lot but I'm charging you extra this time so that you won't lose it again. I will be waiting.

no.0: Are you refusing because the fee is too high? You shouldn't have lost it in the first palce. I won't lower the price.

1.0: You brought all of the materials. Please give them to me along with the fee.

yes.0: Here is the newly made saddle. Please use this incident as a lesson and be careful not to lose it again.

item.0: You do remember what the materials were right? The #b2 #t4032505#s#k, which can be obtained from Aqua Road Ocean I.C, Crystal George, Red Coral Forest, or Turban Shell Hill. And, #m251000000#'s specialty, #b2 pieces of #t4032477##k. Oh, and don't forget to bring a service fee of #b60 million Mesos#k.
